summary: Bar Us is an intimate, reservation-friendly cocktail bar on Sukhumvit 26. Its menu treats drinks like a restaurant course, moving from lighter starters through savory mains to dessert-like afters, with a separate classics section. Expect an ingredient-led tasting experience and premium Bangkok cocktail prices.
whyGo: Try inventive drinks built with Thai and food-inspired ingredients; the current menu includes tom kha, beef and onion, Thai tea punch, and pandan.
The dark, theatrical drinking-room setting makes this a focused destination for cocktail enthusiasts.
bestFor: Cocktail fans who enjoy savory, unfamiliar flavor combinations and guided menu exploration.
A planned date-night or special-occasion stop near Phrom Phong.
skipIf: You want inexpensive drinks, a large group-friendly pub, or a conventional bar menu.
Strong savory, fermented, herbal, or spirit-forward flavors are unappealing.
duration: Allow 1.5–2 hours for a few drinks; this is a planning estimate, not a fixed seating duration.
cost: Current official menu lists most cocktails at THB 480–520, with some classics up to THB 680; add 10% service and 7% VAT. Budget about THB 1,100–1,800 per person for two or three drinks including charges (estimate; food and extra drinks cost more).
hours: Official listing: daily, 6 pm–midnight Sunday–Thursday and from 6 pm Friday–Saturday. Confirm near the visit, especially for holiday changes.
bestTime: Book the 6 pm or 8 pm sitting for a planned visit; walk-ins are accepted throughout the night, subject to seats. Arrive on time because Bangkok traffic can delay cross-town journeys.
gettingThere: At 61/37 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei. Use a taxi or ride-hail to the address and allow traffic buffer. The venue lists parking in its alley and at Grand Four Wings Hotel (THB 40/hour); public-transit walking time was not verified, so check a live map from your hotel.
booking: Reservations are offered at 6 pm and 8 pm via the official booking page; walk-ins are welcome all night. The venue says seats are assigned subject to availability, and booked seats are held for 10 minutes. No strict dress code; wear polite attire.
accessibility: Step-free access, lift availability, accessible toilets, and seating accommodations are not documented in the checked official information. Contact the venue before visiting if these matter.
practicalTips: Menu prices exclude 10% service and 7% VAT; check the menu again before ordering because cocktails and prices can change.
Ask staff for a flavor-led recommendation and explain ingredients or styles you avoid.
The official site lists +66 91 721 8209 for direct questions.
decemberNotes: December is a busy Bangkok travel period. Reserve ahead if you have a preferred time, recheck hours and menu shortly before going, and leave extra time for evening traffic. No December 2026 event or holiday schedule was confirmed; do not assume the standard hours apply on special dates.
uncertainties: December 2026 holiday opening hours and any special menu or events are not yet confirmed.
Transit walking route and step-free accessibility details could not be verified from the official pages checked.
Menu and pricing are current at research time and may change before the trip.
